ui-polish-fix-chat.title: Chat polish — Fraunces empty state, paw-toe thinking, hairline, banner typography, locale
ui-polish-fix-chat.description: Implement polish_report.md findings #6, #7, #8, #10, #12, #14. ULTRATHINK first. Per Track A §4.4 + D1 §4.1, the InkGhost (8% Ink) hairline above Final must be present. Per motion spec §4, the thinking indicator is paw-toes filling in sequence (225/450/675/900ms) — replace generic 3-dots. Per D1 §4.2, the empty-state question uses serifItalic (Fraunces italic), the empty-state title uses Fraunces. Per D1 §6.5, Setup Issue header is tracked-caps labelSmall + monoBody body. Timestamps must follow app locale, not device locale leak.
acceptCriteria: Empty-state title uses Fraunces; empty-state question uses Fraunces italic (serifItalic token)
Paw watermark on empty state is sized as a watermark (≥160dp visual), Ink-tinted
Thinking indicator implements paw-toe sequence per motion spec §4 (NOT generic dots)
Visible InkGhost hairline rule between trace and Final block in expanded completed row
Setup Issue banner header is tracked-caps labelSmall; body uses monoBody
Timestamps render in app locale (English/24h or app-driven), not device-locale Chinese AM/PM
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug passes
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest passes
ui-polish-fix-chat.note: Avoid touching ChatEventReducer.kt or MessageRecord.kt (owned by ui-logic-fix-pr-a/b). MessageBubble.kt may need touching for hairline — coordinate at merge.

ui-polish-fix-runtime-bugs.title: Runtime bugs — supplement Done no-op + stale Setup Issue banner
ui-polish-fix-runtime-bugs.description: Implement polish_report.md B-1 + B-2 (already-diagnosed runtime bugs). ULTRATHINK before edits. B-1: ChatScreen.onUserResponse does not call CapsuleStateHolder.onUserResponseSent(callId). Add hook in ChatScreen.kt:153 mirroring the Stop pattern + add onUserResponseSent to CapsuleBinding. B-2: MainActivity.deriveRepairModel() runs once in setContent; not recomputed in onResume. Convert repairModel to mutableStateOf, recompute in onResume / on lifecycle resume.
